metaDescription: Enquire, visit campus, and join Lawrence High School ICSE, HSR Layout — from Kindergarten to Grade 10.
applyBody: Let's begin your child's journey. Share a few details and our Admissions Team will get in touch with you shortly.
visitNote: Prefer to visit first? See the map on the

steps.title: Make an Enquiry
steps.text: Fill the enquiry form or get in touch. Our team will reach out to schedule a visit or interaction.

steps.title: Visit Us
steps.text: Tour our campus and meet us, in person or online.

steps.title: Apply for Admission
steps.text: Fill and submit the application form along with the required documents.

steps.title: Admission Interaction
steps.text: Once the paperwork is submitted, we will schedule face to face meetings and/or placement tests to check grade readiness. Details may vary by grade level.

steps.title: Admission Offer
steps.text: Once approved, you will receive an offer via email. Confirm your acceptance and pay the required fee within the stipulated time.

feesNote: Figures for the current academic year are shared by the admissions office during your campus visit, or on the helpline. We do not publish last year’s numbers here so families always receive the latest schedule.

fees.name: Admission fee
fees.covers: One-time joining fee for a new student.

fees.name: Tuition
fees.covers: Teaching, campus facilities, and the school-day programme.

fees.name: Transport
fees.covers: Optional school bus on available routes.
fees.when: If opted, with the transport desk

fees.name: Books & uniform
fees.covers: Issued through school vendors at the start of the year.
